introHtml: PL classic C handle mugs combine the timeless appeal of a traditional campfire mug with the durability needed for daily use. These mugs feature a comfortable C-shaped handle and are available in various sizes from 14 oz to 18 oz, making them ideal for coffee, tea, or hot chocolate. Customize with your logo using full-color imprinting to create memorable branded giveaways for trade shows, employee appreciation, or client gifts.
